channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Maritime security in Black Sea under serious threat: Erdoğan
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has underlined that recent escalations in the Black Sea seriously threaten maritime security, while warning Russia and Ukraine that attacks on commercial vessels will not benefit anyone.

item.title: Şanlıurfa nominated as world gastronomy city for 2029
item.description: The southeastern province of Şanlıurfa has been nominated as a candidate for the world’s leading gastronomy city for 2029 by an international gastronomy and tourism organization, the mayor has announced.

item.title: Istanbul streets become living canvas in GPS-based art project
item.description: Istanbul’s streets have been turned into a moving canvas as part of a multidisciplinary artwork, "Istanbul Map: Art of Running," marking the 30th anniversary of the Turkish Educational Volunteers Foundation (TEGV).

item.title: Indo-Pacific crab spotted for 1st time in Türkiye amid tropicalization effect
item.description: A university in the southern province of Hatay has reported the first observation of a reddish-purple, grooved crab species, Liomera rugipes, of Indo-Pacific origin in the İskenderun Bay, highlighting the intensifying effects of climate change in the Mediterranean.

item.title: Germany's Merz hails EU auto measures, industry group calls them 'disastrous'
item.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz Tuesday hailed the EU's proposals to help the struggling auto sector and manufacturers gave them a cautious welcome — but an industry group slammed the measures as "disastrous".

item.title: Trump imposes full travel bans on seven more countries, Palestinians
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday sharply expanded a travel ban by barring people from seven more countries including Syria, as well as Palestinian Authority passport holders, from entering the United States.

item.title: Syria says caught ISIL-linked cell behind shooting attack in northwest
item.description: Syria's government on Tuesday said its forces killed the leader of a cell linked to the ISIL terror group and arrested eight of its members believed to be behind a deadly attack on security personnel last week.

item.title: Kremlin says European participation would hinder Ukraine talks
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin's spokesman indicated Tuesday that the Kremlin opposes European participation in talks on ending the conflict in Ukraine based on a U.S. plan.

item.title: Trump orders blockade of 'sanctioned' Venezuela oil tankers
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump announced Tuesday a blockade of "sanctioned oil vessels" heading to and leaving Venezuela, sharply escalating his pressure campaign against Caracas while issuing new demands for access to the country's crude.

item.title: Fresh rains flood streets in war-scarred Gaza
item.description: Some pushed cars through the Gaza Strip's flooded streets, while others took to donkey-pulled carts to wade through the floodwaters after fresh winter rains lashed the war-battered Palestinian territory.
